note: Advisory only. Hand-curated regulator profiles that pre-seed the init wizard's allow-list walk with conservative defaults derived from each regulator's published guidance as of the retrieval date. Never legal advice; never a determination of filing sufficiency; every seeded jurisdiction remains operator-editable in the walk. Never auto-updated from regulator websites.

profile.seats: list of supported seats this profile applies to (advisory binding; mismatch with --home warns but proceeds)
profile.regulator: display name of the issuing regulator
profile.citation: {url, retrieved} link to the guidance the defaults derive from
profile.defaults: per-classification allow-list of jurisdiction tokens (recognised vocabulary only)
profile.notes: optional free-text explaining the conservative choices
profile.reviewed: ISO-8601 date this profile was last human-reviewed

hkma.notes: Conservative product-policy seed informed by the HKMA's Annex A ART guidance (15 Oct 2026). This is not a regulatory localisation mandate: the guidance does not itself require onshore processing. The home seat (hk) is always seeded for every class; add destinations deliberately in the walk, citing your own outsourcing and data-risk assessment.

mas.notes: Conservative product-policy seed informed by the MAS Information Paper on Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) Model Risk Management (05 Dec 2024), which remains the current citation. The final Guidelines on Artificial Intelligence Risk Management for Financial Institutions were issued on 07 Oct 2026, take effect on 07 Oct 2027, and Sections 5-6 are due on 07 Oct 2028; they complement rather than supersede the paper and do not impose an onshore-only rule. The home seat (sg) is always seeded; extend the allow-list in the walk only where your outsourcing, PDPA and model-risk assessments support it.
